using namespace std;

class FastWriter {
public:
    FastWriter() {}
    FastWriter& p(Object object) { out << object; return *this; }
    FastWriter& p(const string& format, ...) {
        va_list args;
        va_start(args, format);
        vprintf(format.c_str(), args);
        va_end(args);
        return *this;
    }
    FastWriter& pp(const Object&... args) {
        for (const auto& arg : {args...}) out << arg << " ";
        out << "\n";
        return *this;
    }
    FastWriter& pp(const int&... args) {
        for (const auto& arg : {args...}) out << arg << " ";
        out << "\n";
        return *this;
    }
    FastWriter& pp(const long&... args) {
        for (const auto& arg : {args...}) out << arg << " ";
        out << "\n";
        return *this;
    }
    FastWriter& pp(const char&... args) {
        for (const auto& arg : {args...}) out << arg << " ";
        out << "\n";
        return *this;
    }
    void close() { cout << out.str(); }
private:
    stringstream out;
};

class FastScanner {
public:
    FastScanner() : sin(cin.rdbuf()) {}
    string next() {
        string str;
        while (true) {
            int c = sin.get();
            if (c == -1) return "";
            if (c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\t') continue;
            str += c;
            break;
        }
        while (true) {
            int c = sin.get();
            if (c == -1) break;
            if (c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\t') break;
            str += c;
        }
        return str;
    }
    int intNext() {
        string str = next();
        return stoi(str);
    }
    long longNext() {
        string str = next();
        return stoll(str);
    }
    double doubleNext() {
        string str = next();
        return stod(str);
    }
    vector<int> nextIntArray(int n) {
        vector<int> arr(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) arr[i] = intNext();
        return arr;
    }
    vector<long> nextLongArray(int n) {
        vector<long> arr(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) arr[i] = longNext();
        return arr;
    }
};

void solver() {
    long n = in.longNext();
    vector<long> ar(3), br(3);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) ar[i] = in.longNext();
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) br[i] = in.longNext();
    long mxWins = 0;
    long mxLosesOrDraw = 0;
    long draws = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        mxWins += min(ar[i], br[(i + 1) % 3]);
        long mxLose = min(br[i], ar[(i + 1) % 3]);
        long mxDraw = min(br[i], ar[i]);
        mxLosesOrDraw += min(br[i], mxLose + mxDraw);
    }
    out.p(n - mxLosesOrDraw, mxWins).close();
}
